name: Elshan Neymatov
heroLead: Brand designer and Chapter Lead. Design systems, teams and processes for

stories.title: Team Leadership
stories.text: I hire designers, match projects to their strengths, and give feedback through regular design reviews.

stories.title: Design Strategy
stories.text: I set design priorities based on business goals and user needs. I help the team decide what to tackle first and why.

stories.title: Brand & Product
stories.text: I bring product and marketing teams together so the way we talk about the product matches how it looks and works.

stories.title: Design Systems
stories.text: I build reusable components and document when to use them, so teams can ship new features without redesigning common patterns.

meetupText: When a company doesn't have design yet, it hires one person — and everything depends on whether that person builds a system or just puts out fires one task at a time.
contactText: Tell me what you're building and where design hurts today. A few lines are enough to start.
